hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom AMM hook for Uniswap v4 that implements a custom bonding curve backed by two Euler lending vaults. In beforeSwap, the hook fully intercepts each swap: it computes the output via its own curve invariant, deposits input tokens into an Euler vault, withdraws output tokens from another vault, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta to the pool manager — bypassing standard CLAMM pricing entirely.
